Henry Big Boy Conversion.info:
Load your Henry 45-70 with .357 Magnum, making it the Henry Big Boy.
Bring back nostalgia of an era you were not even born in.

MP5 .40 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9/10 into .40 Smith & Wesson.
Less recoil for better accuracy for decreased close range damage and bullet speed, long range damage is preserved.

P.A.W.S. 45 Conversion.info:
Load your L2A3 with .45 ACP.
This is less a Sterling L2A3, and more of its own thing. The Police Automatic Weapons System ZX-7 was the result of a wish to import the Soveran L2A3 into the Grand Federation. More power in close range with more felt recoil.

USAS-12 Semi Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your USAS-12 to make it able to fire in semi-automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less firerate. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

X95 5.56x30 Conversion.info: An experimental version of the X95 chambered in 5.56x30mm MINSAS for the Sindhara Army. It was ultimately cancelled, but that doesn't stop you! Reduces close range damage while massively boosting muzzle velocity and damage at range.

TRG 375.info: A conversion kit that transforms the gun into the TRG-S, firing the famed .30-06 cartridge. Trades performance at range for a significantly long one-shot kill to any part of the body.

.50 Beowulf Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with custom 12.7x42mm blanks! Despite your small reserve pool, you get a large boost to your range potential with poorer velocity and close range performance.

X95R 5.56 Conversion.info:
Convert your X95R to fire 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

S-12U 50 Conversion.info:
Load your Saiga-12U with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- ok, there is no way you're going to get anything working this way...

M3822 Dart Conversion.info: Load your AF2011-A1 into two barrel loaded darts. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

PARA .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

Beowulf .458 Conversion.info:
Loads your Neowulf TCR rifle with .458 SOCOM.

Lowers recoil and increases velocity at the cost of performance, but also doubles your magazine capacity.

M45A1 Dart Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M45A1 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

SL-8 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your VG-98 with .300 Whisper.
 Effectively making it an VG-98S, a specially designed round made to fire at subsonic sound levels. It is a very big bullet that works very well with suppressors!

.36 Caliber NA.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

S-12U 308 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with .308 Winchester.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

G36C .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91C with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

MG36 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your MG91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group, it offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

7.62 Conversion (Type 88).info: Retool your TYPE 88 into the TYPE 58, a 7.62x39mm rifle adopted by Hwanmok in 1958 using a 30 round magazine. A lot more power thanks to the new cartridge, however a lot less recoil control.

KOV 9mm Conversion.info:
Load your Krinkov with 9x19mm.
 It uses a specialty magwell adapter so it can accept SMX-9 styled magazines.
Now it can be a 'true pdw' (even though it already was before)!

TFIX 65Cree.info: Swap your caliber over to 6.5 Creedmoor. Faster projectile velocity and improved performance at longer range.

MSG90 308 Conversion.info:
Load your JG-90 with .308 Winchester.
Giving a familiar 10 round magazine, Your JG-90 now has the benefits of the .308 cartridge which include faster velocities and the ability to kill to the head. Alongside being a whole lot lighter.

Pedersen Device.info:
The M1918 Pedersen Device was an experimental conversion for the M1903 firing the .30-18 Auto cartridge. Replacing a majority of your M1903 Springfields parts to allow it to fire in semi-automatic. Feeds from a large 40 round magazine.

Incompatible with the Marksman Kit.

.36 Caliber C.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

Colt LMG 25-45 Conversion.info:
Loads your LSV M/04 with .20 Tactical.
This uses the typical 30-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.
